note: Add the new verb as a first-positional command per ADR-0069 with a single shared synopsis and help entry (ADR-0190), and implement upgrade with atomic self-replace, sha256 verification and skill refresh, fetching via the releases.json and direct-route-first mechanism rather than the superseded ADR-0069 §3/§4 API fetch.

Validation is already incremental, so build on the ADR-0173 redo-log cursor and the ADR-0172 recheck set, error selection and transaction rules, plus ADR-0174 catalog drift, keeping the ADR-0184/0185 probes and their identical accept/reject results.

Multiple databases would extend the store-level DatabasesCatalog (ADR-0276), which currently fixes the namespaces, while preserving the live administration, USE routing and SHOW output rules and the SHOW DATABASES record shapes.

Any change to hosting, platforms or invocation must respect ADR-0585's unauthenticated direct-route installer (replacing ADR-0068 §6/§7) and ADR-0546's release-asset publishing, and amend the live ADR-0068 URL, hosting, platform and asset clauses explicitly.

The same-clause self-reference rule from ADR-0513 §1 now applies to every statement since ADR-0584 removed the CYPHER 5 stand-down, so tighten the check in that version-free form while keeping the live null-binding 22N01 rule and the TCK re-pin.

Add the event to the ADR-0079 §4 taxonomy with no query text, paths or parameter values, and deliver it through the ADR-0545 spool and next-run drain rather than the superseded ADR-0079 §5 in-run channel, honouring the opt-out and updating docs in the same change.
